description: Add HTML settings page for Backup Management with Restic + MinIO architecture. Configure MinIO endpoints, Restic repository settings, view backup history/status, trigger manual backups, manage retention policies, and configure backup schedules.
steps: Step 1 - Add backup settings to app/core/config.py: MINIO_PRIMARY_ENDPOINT, MINIO_PRIMARY_ACCESS_KEY, MINIO_PRIMARY_SECRET_KEY, MINIO_PRIMARY_BUCKET, MINIO_DR_ENDPOINT, MINIO_DR_ACCESS_KEY, MINIO_DR_SECRET_KEY, MINIO_DR_BUCKET, RESTIC_REPOSITORY, RESTIC_PASSWORD, BACKUP_SCHEDULE (cron string), BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS (default 30).

Step 2 - Create app/models/backup.py with SQLAlchemy models: BackupJob (id, status, started_at, finished_at, size_bytes, files_count, target, error_message), BackupSchedule (id, cron_expression, is_active, last_run, next_run), BackupConfig (id, config_key, config_value, updated_at).

Step 3 - Create app/services/backup.py service with: BackupService class that manages Restic operations (init repo, run backup, list snapshots, check status, restore). Since Restic may not be installed, implement with subprocess calls wrapped in try/except. Also add MinIO connectivity check via httpx calls to MinIO health endpoints.

Step 4 - Create app/api/settings_backup.py router with: GET /settings/backup (HTML page), GET /api/settings/backup/config (JSON current config), POST /api/settings/backup/config (update config), GET /api/settings/backup/history (list backup jobs), POST /api/settings/backup/run (trigger manual backup), GET /api/settings/backup/status (current backup status), GET /api/settings/backup/retention (retention policies). Protect with require_permission('settings', 'manage').

Step 5 - Create app/templates/settings_backup.html template showing: MinIO endpoint configuration (primary + DR), Restic repo settings, backup history table, manual backup trigger button, retention policy display, schedule configuration (cron). Use htmx for dynamic status refresh.
Step 6 - Register the new router in app/api/router.py. Add BackupJob model to models/__init__.py.
Step 7 - Add navigation link to base.html for Settings > Backup.
Step 8 - Add tests in tests/test_settings_backup.py covering: settings page loads, config endpoints, backup history endpoint, manual backup trigger (mocked subprocess).
acceptance_criteria: GET /settings/backup returns an HTML page with backup configuration
Backup history is viewable with status/timestamps
Manual backup can be triggered via API
BackupJob model tracks backup history in the database
Tests pass for backup settings endpoints
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
findings: All 192 tests pass (181 existing + 11 new). Lint clean. Background task for backup uses try/except to handle DB errors gracefully (in tests, the background task uses a different DB engine than the test fixture). Config updates are runtime-only (not persisted to .env). BackupService handles missing restic binary gracefully. get_db_session async context manager added to database.py for use outside FastAPI dependency injection.
